description: Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission Ref. PP/24/00662, granted on 10 June 2024, as amended by Ref. PP/23/01117 granted on 09 November 2023 (Upwards extensions of the buildings to provide additional hotel accommodation, use of ground floor as caf‚, retail and hotel lobby and associated improvement to shop frontages, use of basement as additional hotel floorspace and reconfiguration of the existing hotel bedrooms), namely to provide a fourth floor mansard roof extension, setback from the roofline to provide two hotel units, together with a slight raising of the parapet to maintain proportion, and the rewording of relevant conditions to become compliance conditions reflecting details already approved.
